messages:
marta: quick sync on per-tenant acceptability budgets for low-bit profiles — customer A flagged small but visible semantic drift on helpdesk conversations.
alex: saw that. drift shows up as 1-2 token factual swaps late in convo, deg_score ~0.02. likely fp8 head saturation on long ctx.
linh: repro locally. two options: tighten profile (raise safe thresholds) or add per-tenant budget that limits aggressive lanes for sensitive tenants.
ben: ops note: per-tenant profiles explode config surface. suggest default safe_profile + optional overrides. overrides should be small (enum + numeric budget) not full profile uploads.
sam: propose API: precision_budget: {"mode":"safe|balanced|aggressive","max_deg": "0.03"} — simple, easy to validate, and cheap to route on.
marta: agree on compact API. also need routing rules: if tenant sets max_deg < X, route to stable lanes and disable experimental fp8.
alex: telemetry: emit tenant_budget and actual_deg per request. add alert if actual_deg exceeds budget for 1h.
linh: implement quick-check: offline eval per-tenant using representative prompts to recommend default mode. store recommendation in console.
ben: action items: @sam draft API + validation, @linh run per-tenant eval recommendations, @alex add telemetry fields and alerting, @marta update RFC with budget model.
marta: keep header footprint small; do not add heavy per-request blobs. just a budget id or enum. we'll iterate. :thumbsup:
